idea: Abandoned cart recovery: remind shoppers who left items in their cart with a timely email and an easy way back to checkout.

prd.title: Abandoned cart recovery
prd.problem: Many shoppers add items to the cart and leave without paying. The store has no follow-up, so interested customers are lost, and any follow-up that is too aggressive risks annoying them and breaching consent rules.
personas: Hesitant shopper: left items in the cart and may return if reminded at the right moment
E-commerce manager: wants to recover revenue without damaging the brand
goals: Recover a measurable share of abandoned carts
Keep reminders relevant, limited in number and easy to opt out of
success_metrics: Recovered cart rate (abandoned carts that end in a paid order): increase (baseline not provided)
Unsubscribe rate from reminder emails: stay low (threshold not provided)
scope_in: Reminder email after a cart is abandoned
requirements: The system must send a reminder email to a signed-in shopper who abandoned a cart
The system must send at most one follow-up reminder
The system must restore the cart contents when the shopper follows the email link
The system must stop reminders once the shopper completes a purchase
The system must honour an unsubscribe request in every reminder
risks: Privacy and consent rules for marketing email - mitigation: send only to shoppers who accepted communications, with one-click unsubscribe
Items out of stock when the shopper returns - mitigation: tell the shopper which items are no longer available
assumptions: Assumption: a cart counts as abandoned after 1 hour without checkout; the idea does not define it
Assumption: only signed-in shoppers can be reached, because the store has their email
open_questions: What is the right waiting time before the first reminder?
Which consent record does the store keep for marketing email?
as_is: Shoppers who leave items in the cart receive no contact.
Recovery depends on the shopper coming back on their own.
to_be: A signed-in shopper who abandons a cart receives a reminder email.
At most one follow-up is sent.
Following the link restores the cart.
business_rules: RN01: At most one follow-up reminder is sent per abandoned cart.
RN02: Reminders stop as soon as the shopper completes a purchase.
RN03: Every reminder carries a working unsubscribe link, and an unsubscribe is honoured immediately.
expected_returns: Operational efficiency: share of abandoned carts recovered (baseline not provided)

stories.title: Send a reminder after cart abandonment
stories.i_want: to receive one email reminding me of the items I left in my cart
stories.so_that: I can finish the purchase without searching again
stories.prd_ref: requirements: send a reminder email to a signed-in shopper

scenarios.name: Reminder is sent after the waiting time
given: a signed-in shopper who accepted emails left items in the cart
then: the shopper receives a reminder listing the items left in the cart

scenarios.name: No reminder without consent
given: a signed-in shopper who did not accept marketing emails left items in the cart

stories.title: Send one follow-up after 24 hours
stories.i_want: a single follow-up reminder 24 hours after the first one when the cart is still open
stories.so_that: more shoppers come back without being over-contacted
stories.prd_ref: requirements: send at most one follow-up reminder

scenarios.name: Follow-up is sent once
given: a shopper received a first reminder and did not buy
then: the shopper receives one follow-up reminder

scenarios.name: No third reminder
given: a shopper received a reminder and a follow-up and did not buy

stories.title: Restore my cart from the email link
stories.i_want: to return to a cart with my items already in it when I follow the email link
stories.so_that: I can go straight to checkout

scenarios.name: Cart is restored
given: a shopper received a reminder for a cart with two items
then: the cart shows the same two items
the shopper can proceed to checkout

scenarios.name: Unavailable items are explained
given: one of the two items is now out of stock
then: the cart contains the available item
the shopper is told which item is no longer available

stories.title: Unsubscribe from reminders
stories.i_want: to stop receiving cart reminders with one click from any reminder

scenarios.name: Unsubscribe takes effect immediately
when: the shopper uses the unsubscribe link
then: the shopper is confirmed as unsubscribed
no further cart reminders are sent

scenarios.name: Pending follow-up is cancelled
given: a shopper received a first reminder and has a follow-up scheduled
then: the scheduled follow-up is not sent

stories.title: Stop reminders after purchase
stories.i_want: reminders to stop as soon as I complete my order
stories.so_that: I am not nagged about something I already bought
stories.prd_ref: requirements: stop reminders once the shopper completes a purchase

scenarios.name: Reminder stops after purchase
given: a shopper received a first reminder
when: the shopper completes the order before the follow-up

scenarios.name: Partial purchase keeps the rest
given: a shopper left three items and buys one of them
then: the follow-up lists only the two remaining items

reviews.comment: Estimable: the abandonment waiting time is an open question in the PRD; size assumes one hour.

Original: 'As a manager, I want reminders sent at the right time, so that sales increase' (3 points). 'Right time' is not testable; rewritten with the single follow-up after 24 hours that the PRD requires.

rewrite.title: Send one follow-up after 24 hours
rewrite.i_want: a single follow-up reminder 24 hours after the first one when the cart is still open
rewrite.so_that: more shoppers come back without being over-contacted
rewrite.prd_ref: requirements: send at most one follow-up reminder

reviews.comment: Original: restore the cart, handle stock, prices and coupons (8 points, more than one sprint with the stock rules). Cut price and coupon handling; the shopper is told which items are unavailable.

rewrite.title: Restore my cart from the email link
rewrite.i_want: to return to a cart with my items already in it when I follow the email link
rewrite.so_that: I can go straight to checkout

reviews.comment: Small and testable; nothing to flag. Check that the unsubscribe link also works when opened on another device.
Independent: it relies on the reminder schedule from S1 and S2, but it can be tested with the schedule stubbed.
